BALLOON FESTIVAL LEADER: a tall rounded envelope in wide tangerine and cream stripes swelling full, a painted sun face on its leading panel, a plaited wicker basket hung with a lantern on a bent hook, four smaller balloons drifting tiny and far behind it

BALLOON FESTIVAL RISING PAIR: a fat chequered envelope in red and yellow climbing nearest and largest, its plaited basket trailing a knotted rope below, three more balloons small and distant behind it each leaning gently on the air

BALLOON FESTIVAL MORNING CLUSTER: a broad envelope in wide blue and white panels billowing at the front of a loose gathering, a string of paper flags looped along its rigging, five smaller balloons small and far behind it

BALLOON FESTIVAL PATCHWORK LEAD: a rounded envelope stitched from mismatched cloth gores in green, ochre, and rust rising closest and biggest, a wicker basket with a folded canvas awning, four smaller balloons trailing small and far below

BALLOON FESTIVAL TALL STRIPES: a tall narrow striped envelope in violet and cream stripes pulling ahead, a solid red pennant on a line at the basket rail, a coil of rope over the rail, three smaller balloons small and far behind it

LONE CHEQUERED BALLOON: a rounded envelope in a bold red and white chequerboard pattern swelling full, a plaited wicker basket beneath it with a lantern hooked to one corner, a long knotted rope trailing down from the basket rim

LONE PATCHED BALLOON: a soft rounded envelope of oatmeal canvas with one mismatched indigo panel stitched in, a painted crescent moon on the patched panel, a wicker basket with a rope ladder coiled over its side

LONE TALL NARROW BALLOON: a very tall narrow envelope in deep green and gold stripes billowing taut, a small varnished timber gondola slung on four ropes beneath it, a solid yellow pennant fluttering from the gondola bow

LONE FAT ROUNDED BALLOON: a very fat rounded envelope in wide rust and cream panels swelling broad, a plaited wicker basket with a folded canvas awning and a coil of rope hung over the rail, a short ribbon tail at the crown

CANVAS AIRSHIP CREAM: a long soft envelope of stitched cream canvas rounding out gently, plain cloth fins at the tail, a small varnished timber gondola slung on ropes beneath it, a painted fish on the nose panel

CANVAS AIRSHIP OATMEAL PATCH: a long stitched oatmeal canvas envelope with one mismatched rust patch near the bow, plain cloth fins at the tail, a small timber gondola slung on rope lines, a solid blue pennant at the stern

CANVAS AIRSHIP BLUE STRIPES: a long soft envelope of stitched canvas in wide blue and white stripes billowing full, plain cloth fins at the tail, a small varnished gondola beneath on ropes, a string of paper flags looped along the rigging

CANVAS AIRSHIP TAN: a long rounded envelope of stitched tan canvas with a painted star near the tail, broad plain cloth fins, a small bare timber gondola slung on four ropes, a coil of rope coiled over the gondola rail

PAPER DIAMOND KITE TRAIN: a long climbing line of fifteen paper diamonds in alternating red and white, each with a short ribbon tail, the whole train curving up taut on a single string running down out of frame
BOX KITE: a broad open box kite of stitched yellow and green panels stretched over a light timber frame, two fabric ribbon tails streaming behind it, the taut line running down out of frame

FISH KITE: a big fish-shaped paper kite in orange with a painted eye and paper fin details, its body billowing round on the wind, a long ribbon tail waving behind it, the string running taut down out of frame

SLENDER GLIDER: a slender glider of doped pale fabric stretched over a light wooden frame, wings broad and gently curved, an open cockpit with a simple timber rail, a solid red pennant tied to one wingtip strut

TANDEM GLIDER: a wooden-framed glider with two broad doped fabric wings in cream and ochre panels, a small open cockpit with a rope slung across it, a painted leaf on the leading edge of the port wing

SKY HARBOUR MAIN MAST: two canvas airships tied by rope to tall wooden mooring masts on a hilltop platform, the nearest and biggest a long cream canvas envelope with plain cloth fins, its rope mooring running down to the mast, a little plank walkway crossing between them, a smaller airship far behind

SKY HARBOUR ROCK PLATFORM: three canvas airships moored by long ropes to timber masts on a high rock platform, the closest a fat oatmeal envelope with a painted crescent moon at the bow, plank walkways connecting the masts, two smaller airships behind it

SKY HARBOUR HILLTOP TIES: two stitched canvas airships roped to tall wooden mooring masts on a hilltop, the nearer one a long blue-striped envelope with a small gondola and a string of paper flags, a rope ladder hanging from the gondola, the second smaller and behind

COASTAL BLIMP ROUND: a soft rounded blimp of plain oatmeal cloth swelling full and gentle, a small timber cabin slung beneath it on ropes, a solid red pennant at the cabin bow, a sandbag on a hook at the cabin side

COASTAL BLIMP STRIPED: a soft rounded blimp of wide green and white striped cloth billowing broad, a small varnished timber cabin beneath it on rope lines, a painted bird on the nose, a coil of rope over the cabin rail

PARAGLIDER BOLD PANELS: a broad fabric wing in two bold panels of red and yellow billowing into a wide curve, long lines running down to a small seated pilot far below, a short solid pennant tied midway along the leading edge

PARAGLIDER BLUE AND WHITE: a wide fabric paraglider wing in two bold blue and white panels swelling gently full, long thin lines trailing down to a small seated pilot far below, a folded cloth tail streamer tied at one corner
